Number of studies.evidence_source: Sexual orientation was collected using a self-reported, open-ended question, "What words do you use to describe your sexual orientation?" for Study 1 and a similar question for Study 2, "What is your sexual orientation?"

section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes use of the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS; Avalos et al., 2005) with high internal reliability (Cronbach's α = .92) and a reported mean BAS score of 3.64 (SD = 0.69). Sexual orientation was assessed (questions used in Study 1 and a similar item in Study 2), with the majority identifying as heterosexual (69.5%) and bisexual participants comprising n = 131 (14.5%); BMI was computed from self-reported height and weight with a mean of 26.24 (SD = 6.80).
